payload.purpose_context: Run journals, per-Mission glossary logs and local caches under .kittify/ grow without bound because nothing cleans them up (ADR 2026-10-13-2 D-3, gap G-9). This Mission first records, for every state surface, how it is retained and which command cleans it (#5212), then adds spec-kitty doctor event-logs, which previews by default and deletes only with --apply, reading which surfaces it may touch from that one policy (#6610). Committed ledgers are never pruned.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give every local state surface a declared cleanup policy and add a dry-run-first command that prunes old, gitignored run journals, event logs and caches.

payload.question: Confirm the Intent Summary and extracted FR/NFR/C set for local event-log retention
